items.text: What time do you get up?
items.reading: ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm duː juː ˈɡɛt ˈʌp?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What time do you get up, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm duː juː ˈɡɛt ˈʌp, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: At six o'clock in the morning.
dialogue.reading: ət ˈsɪks əˈklɑːk ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I take a shower and have breakfast.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈteɪk ə ˈʃaʊər ənd ˈhæv ˈbrɛkfəst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What time do you go to class?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm duː juː ˈɡoʊ tə ˈklæs?
